title: Roasted Pepper and Garlic Wraps with Spinach
blurb: Soft tortillas filled with sweet roasted peppers, garlicky cream cheese and fresh baby spinach, with a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Cut the peppers into thick strips, discarding the seeds and cores.
Peel the garlic cloves and leave them whole. Toss the peppers and garlic with the olive oil on a baking tray, then roast for 25 minutes until the peppers are soft and slightly charred at the edges.
While the vegetables roast, put the cream cheese in a small bowl and grate in the zest from half the lemon. Squeeze in a little lemon juice and stir until smooth and spreadable.
When the peppers are done, remove them from the oven and crush the soft garlic cloves with a fork, mixing them through the peppers.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave. Spread each tortilla with the lemon cream cheese, then add a handful of baby spinach leaves down the centre.
Divide the roasted peppers and garlic between the tortillas, season with black pepper, and squeeze over a little more lemon juice. Roll up tightly and serve warm or at room temperature.
